svg.aria-label: Animated diagram of the candidate selector: DFlash's independent top picks collide in a stutter and die at verification; DFlash 2 keeps the top candidates per position and a selector traces one path through them, so the verifier accepts the whole block.
svg.desc: Source: Inco AI, DFlash 2: Keep Drafting Parallel, https://inco.ai/blog/dflash2/#figure-1. Static export of the official diagram.
svg.text: all adjacent pairs scored at once → one path kept
